analysis: The PR changes docs/architecture/inference.md only. The patch excerpt shows one added table row at head line 1406 documenting `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`. It describes a paged complete-store effective-token floor for dense Qwen3.5/3.8, with a checkpoint range ending just below the prompt end. The two supplied units (base lines 1612-2039 and 2040-2426) are unchanged surrounding documentation, so I read them for context only. No source, configuration, crypto, authorization or wire behavior is modified. The added row names an engine configuration knob (EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift) that I cannot inspect here. A real checkpoint-boundary change would affect the prefix-cache/SSD posture under T-041. That would cover the DBK3 metadata, HMAC lookup tags, the per-donation gate and the TTL, none of which this doc diff shows changing. The extra end-of-prompt checkpoint could marginally increase donated-at-rest entries. That would be a code-side matter for the code PR (the prefix-cache.md anchor and factory file are outside the supplied evidence), not a documentation regression. The reviewed text does not contradict the T-041 mitigations: cache scope remains coordinator-authored, AES-GCM and HMAC naming are unchanged, and the sliding TTL is unchanged. I did not observe the head text of the added row beyond the patch excerpt. I found no regression and no required threat-model update from the supplied evidence. The patch excerpt is incomplete, so a deeper review is only needed if the paired code change alters the checkpoint donation gate.
